selectionRationale: The 'first dance on clouds' with cold sparkler fountains in Sala Grand is the undisputed peak emotional memory for couples at River Park Events. While architectural symmetry and gastronomy are vital pillars, the celestial stage theme creates an unmatched cinematic aura that elevates Drăgășani into a premier luxury spectacle destination.
businessTruth: River Park Events in Drăgășani features two monumental banquet halls (Sala Grand and Sala Gold) equipped with stage-grade cold pyrotechnics and low-fog generators, supported by an in-house kitchen and 19 boutique hotel rooms on-site at Str. Regele Ferdinand 56.
humanInsight: Couples don't just want a wedding venue; they long for a stage where their first dance feels like an unrepeatable cinematic climax that mesmerizes their family and friends forever.
creativeMetaphor: A haute-couture theater under the open stars—where fog, chandeliers, and golden spark fountains transform a grand ballroom into a celestial stage.
centralMechanism: Atmospheric Lighting & Fog Dissolve: As the user scrolls, lighting transitions from warm ambient dinner tone to dramatic spotlight stage fog, unlocking spatial details and culinary experiences in real time.
signatureMoment: The Interactive First Dance Cloud Simulator: A real-time visual canvas where guests can toggle low-lying fog density, cold-spark fountain height, and ambient LED halo colors across Sala Grand.

interactionGrammar.paceAndMotion: Stately and theatrical. Heavy-mass transitions with slow inertia, mimicking grand stage curtains opening onto illuminated ballrooms.
interactionGrammar.openingMoment: A void of obsidian black gradually illuminated by a sweeping halo chandelier light overlay, revealing the high-contrast architecture of Sala Grand.
interactionGrammar.scrollChoreography: Curtain Wipes & Volumetric Depth Pinning: Sections lock briefly as cold spark particle layers and fog density dissolve into place.
microInteractions: Illuminated venue switch between Sala Grand and Sala Gold

typography.styleNote: Dramatic high-contrast serif headlines in all-caps or majestic italics paired with clean, generous letter-spaced modern sans-serif body text.

visualGrammar.spatialComposition: Full-bleed widescreen frames, extreme dark mode contrast, asymmetric typography overlays with heavy cinematic negative space.

forbiddenAntiPatterns: No generic bright white template backgrounds
No cheap floating social icons or chatbots blocking full-bleed visuals
mandatoryDesignRules: All lighting visuals must reflect real venue cold-spark and fog capabilities
Romanian language typography must use correct diacritics and noble tone
Every interactive element must reinforce spatial grandiosity or ambiance
Image ratios must remain cinematic widescreen
